ReviewI.Integration.both_tests_full_signed_boundary_smooth.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0)
  (v : ℕ → FinitePlace K) (q : Fin 2) (t : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) :
  let h := LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q;
  have ht := ⋯;
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h ⋯ ⋯;
  let V := JThetaAttachment.fullSourceSpan K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  have Theta := OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  let E := DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 Theta;
  have P := (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s)ᗮ.starProjection;
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have p := NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v (NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K);
  have alpha := NDivisorialShells.descendedStratumMask K v (NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K);
  have d := fun T x => DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b (E T) A (fun x y => h (x * y⁻¹)) x x;
  (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      HasSum (fun e => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p e x) * d T x ∂mu)
          (-Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)) ∧
        HasSum (fun n => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(alpha (n + 1) x - alpha n x) * d T x ∂mu)
            (∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p none x) * d T x ∂mu +
              Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)) ∧
          (Summable fun n => ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(alpha (n + 1) x - alpha n x) * d T x ∂mu‖) ∧
            HasSum (fun e => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), (↑(p e x) - ↑(p e (x * t⁻¹))) * d T x ∂mu) 0 ∧
              (Summable fun e => ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), (↑(p e x) - ↑(p e (x * t⁻¹))) * d T x ∂mu‖) ∧
                ∑' (e : Option ℕ), ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), (↑(p e x) - ↑(p e (x * t⁻¹))) * d T x ∂mu‖ ≤
                    2 * ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖d T x‖ ∂mu ∧
                  Tendsto
                    (fun z =>
                      ∑' (e : Option ℕ),
                        ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                              ↑(p e x) * (FSmoothCutoff.mask K z.1 (z.2 / z.1) x * d T x) ∂mu -
                            ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p e x) * d T x ∂mu‖)
                    FPhysicalFilter.cutoffRegime (𝓝 0)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun T => A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) atTop (𝓝 ((P.comp A) F))
'ReviewI.Integration.both_tests_full_signed_boundary_smooth' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
